name: skillvault-evaluate
title: SkillVault Evaluate
description: Evaluate a source URL or skill name for purpose, value, fit, overlap, and risks before deciding whether to upsert it. Reuses installed inventory, catalogs, and the official SkillVault repository before external lookup.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: url|skillName
inputs.description: Source URL or existing SkillVault skill name to evaluate before upsert.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Explicit local path or source URL to evaluate for a named skill, bypassing default name lookup.
